entities.name: Serine hydroxymethyltransferase
observations: The 417-residue query sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q8K9P2, annotated as serine hydroxymethyltransferase.
The enzyme is a cytosolic homodimer and uses pyridoxal 5'-phosphate (PLP) as cofactor.
The sequence contains a strong SHMT domain, Pfam PF00464, spanning residues 9-386.
The catalytic PLP-binding lysine is annotated at position 229 in the exact reference sequence.

source_tools.relevance: Exact sequence identity, curated function, cofactor, subunit, localization, and domain evidence

entities.name: Serine glycine THF interconversion
observations: Rhea RHEA:15481 records the reversible reaction: (6R)-5,10-methylene-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolate + glycine + H2O = (6S)-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolate + L-serine.
The reverse direction is commonly described as L-serine + tetrahydrofolate yielding glycine + 5,10-methylene-tetrahydrofolate.

source_tools.relevance: Curated catalytic reaction and Rhea mapping

entities.name: Pyridoxal 5'-phosphate
observations: PLP is the required enzyme cofactor; the reference annotation identifies a covalent N6-(PLP)lysine catalytic modification.

entities.name: One-carbon metabolism
observations: The enzyme supplies one-carbon units through tetrahydrofolate interconversion and contributes to biosynthesis of purines, thymidylate, methionine, and related metabolites.

entities.name: Glycine biosynthesis
observations: The enzyme catalyzes the glycine-from-L-serine step in amino-acid biosynthesis.
